itemized.notes: wasatch_fcr_3line, cumulative regime, BORN-DIGITAL. Joey Diane Granger (index.csv publishes 'Joey D Granger'), Clerk/Auditor, Republican, dated 12/03/2020, '30 Days after the General Election' checked. SEVEN pages: p1 cover, p2 Form A, p3 Form B, and pp4-7 are the printed statute text of Utah Code 17-16-6.5 (effective 3/17/2016) -- I read all four and they contain NO additional schedule, row or total. Both schedules carry exactly one row each and NEITHER prints an address, so donor_city/donor_state are honestly BLANK (never inferred). Note also that the cover's Form-B row is captioned 'TOTAL EXPENSES', and the single 25.00 contribution and 25.00 expenditure are same-dated (10/30/20).
